reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: ASTM standards for petroleum fuels
headings.reviewNote: Requires kerosene, diesel, heating oil, aviation turbine, and motor fuels to meet annual ASTM standards.

headings.title: Fuel grade and octane inspections
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to inspect motor fuels for advertised grade and octane compliance; caps first-violation penalty at written reprimand.

headings.title: Waiver of fuel requirements during shortages
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to waive fuel standards or establish temporary alternative requirements during extreme or unusual fuel supply shortages.

headings.title: Limitations on supply waiver scope
headings.reviewNote: Mandates waivers be limited in scope and apply uniformly to all petroleum motor fuel market participants.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1987-2018 history notes; all 4 headings retained covering ASTM fuel standards, grade/octane inspections (first-violation reprimand cap), shortage waivers with EPA/30-day/stakeholder duties, and uniform waiver scope.

headings.title: Financial responsibility for tank manufacturers and installers
headings.reviewNote: Requires manufacturers ('manufacturers' verb typo in archived text), installers, and repairers of fuel storage tanks or piping to maintain at least $1M per occurrence and $2M annual aggregate financial responsibility for improper-work releases.

headings.title: Exemption for tank owner self-installation
headings.reviewNote: Exempts tank or piping installation and repairs performed directly by the owner or operator from third-party financial responsibility mandate.

headings.title: Annual filing of financial responsibility evidence
headings.reviewNote: Requires annual presentation of proof of financial responsibility to the director of the department of agriculture.

headings.title: Department rulemaking authority
headings.reviewNote: Directs department of agriculture to promulgate rules implementing tank financial responsibility standards.

headings.title: Compliance with administrative procedures
headings.reviewNote: Conditions effectiveness of delegated rules on compliance with chapter 536 administrative procedures.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 2006 S.B. 1020 history note; all 5 headings retained and subsection 1 note updated for $1M/$2M coverage limits and archived 'manufacturers' verb typo.

headings.title: Aboveground storage tank financial responsibility mandate
headings.reviewNote: Requires aboveground storage tank owners and operators to maintain financial responsibility of at least one million dollars per occurrence after December 31, 2010.

headings.title: Definition of aboveground storage tank
headings.reviewNote: Defines aboveground storage tank containing petroleum with direct connections or nine-tenths capacity above ground.

headings.title: Methods of compliance and insurance fund participation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes compliance via participation in the petroleum storage tank insurance fund under section 319.129 or other approved methods.

headings.title: Rulemaking and statutory nonseverability
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes department rulemaking subject to chapter 536 administrative procedures.

headings.title: Coverage protection for incompatible motor fuel releases
headings.reviewNote: Bars insurance fund or financial responsibility provider from denying benefits solely because claim arises from motor fuel release deemed incompatible with aboveground tank system, except for application fraud or misrepresentation (original-rolls footnote: 'owner').

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text, 2008/2016 history, and original-rolls footnote ('owner' in subsection 5); refined subsection 5 title and note to specify incompatible motor fuel release coverage protection.

headings.title: Testing requirements for petroleum fuels
headings.reviewNote: Requires testing of fuels offered for sale or used in Missouri; requires distributors and retailers to submit samples upon request.

headings.title: Discretionary scope of sample analyses
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to determine necessary tests rather than conducting full chemical analysis on every sample.

headings.title: Rejection of unfit petroleum products
headings.reviewNote: Empowers director to reject fuel containing impurities or imperfections that render it unfit for intended purposes.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1987 S.B. 249 history (effective 1-01-88); all 3 headings retained covering required testing/samples, discretionary analysis scope, and stop-sale rejection.

headings.title: Safe maintenance of fuel storage and dispensing facilities
headings.reviewNote: Requires all premises, bulk storage, terminals, and dispensing devices to be maintained in a safe condition free from leaks or flammability hazards.

headings.title: Right of entry and inspection during business hours
headings.reviewNote: Grants director right of entry during normal business hours to inspect marketing premises, examine records, and collect samples.

headings.title: Semiannual retail and annual marine premises inspections
headings.reviewNote: Requires director to inspect retail premises selling an average of 200+ gallons/month of regulated fuels at least every six months, and marine installations at least annually.

headings.title: Stop-use orders for defective dispensing equipment
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes stop-use orders on hazardous portions of fuel storage or dispensing systems until corrected; requires reinspection within one working day of correction notice.

headings.title: Administrative appeal of stop-use orders
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes aggrieved owners to request a hearing within seventy-two hours of a stop-use order; establishes hearing and circuit court appeal procedures.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1987/1993 history notes; corrected subsection 3 title/note to remove ungrounded stop-sale claim and reflect semiannual retail/annual marine inspections, and refined subsection 4 note.

headings.title: Container requirements for class I flammable liquids
headings.reviewNote: Requires sales of gasoline and class I liquids to be made only in closed red containers marked with product name.

headings.title: Container requirements for class II combustible liquids
headings.reviewNote: Requires sales or purchases of kerosene, diesel, fuel oil, or other class II combustible liquids to be in clearly marked metal or approved containers with tight closure.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1987 S.B. 249 history (effective 1-01-88); both headings retained and subsection 2 note corrected to remove ungrounded non-red color claim.

headings.title: Inspection of retail and wholesale measuring devices
headings.reviewNote: Requires director to test measuring devices of persons selling an average of 200+ gallons/month of regulated fuels at retail or wholesale at least every six months, and marine installations at least annually.

headings.title: Manufacturer expiration dates on pump components
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits manufacturer expiration dates on nozzles, hoses, and breakaway equipment from being the sole basis for requiring replacement.

headings.title: Correction, removal, or discontinuance of inaccurate devices
headings.reviewNote: Directs director to require correction, removal, or discontinuance of any measuring device that does not accurately register monetary cost or volume sold.

headings.title: Device approval policy and bar on volumetric correction
headings.reviewNote: Declares state policy prohibiting retail gasoline/diesel dispensing through devices not approved by department of agriculture or NTEP, and barring automatic volumetric correction devices absent specific statutory authorization.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1987-2011 history notes; corrected subsections 1, 3, and 4 titles/notes to cover wholesale measuring devices, correction/removal/discontinuance (no condemnation/10-day rule), and NTEP/volumetric-correction state policy.

headings.title: Tank wagon meter requirement
headings.reviewNote: Requires all tank wagons marketing regulated petroleum fuels to be equipped with accurate meters.

headings.title: Annual testing of tank wagon measuring devices
headings.reviewNote: Requires director to test measuring devices on tank wagons at least once each year.

headings.title: Application of NIST Handbook 44 standards
headings.reviewNote: Governs test procedures, tolerances, and specifications under National Bureau of Standards Handbook 44.

headings.title: Condemnation of noncompliant meters
headings.reviewNote: Directs condemnation of vehicle tank meters failing to satisfy Handbook 44 requirements.

headings.title: Prohibition on commercial use of condemned meters
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits commercial use of condemned vehicle tank meters and requires conspicuous marking as inaccurate.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1987 S.B. 249 history (effective 1-01-88); all 5 headings retained covering tank wagon meters without bypass, annual testing, NBS Handbook 44 standards, condemnation, and 'inaccurate' marking.

headings.title: Petroleum inspection fee rate
headings.reviewNote: Directs director of revenue to set per-barrel inspection fee approximating chapter administration expenses, capped at 2.5 cents through 2016, 4 cents for 2017-2021, and 5 cents after January 1, 2022.

headings.title: Annual expense reconciliation and fee adjustment
headings.reviewNote: Directs director to reconcile administrative expenses annually and adjust inspection fee within statutory cap.

headings.title: Petroleum inspection fund nonreversion
headings.reviewNote: Protects unexpended fund balance from transfer to general revenue pursuant to section 33.080.

headings.title: Investment of unneeded fund balances
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes state treasurer to invest idle fund balances with interest credited directly to petroleum inspection fund.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1987-2016 history notes; all 4 headings retained and subsection 1 note corrected to reflect tiered 2.5c/4c/5c per-barrel caps without ungrounded 50-gallon/export claims.

headings.title: Monthly reporting and payment of inspection fees
headings.reviewNote: Requires importers and removers of petroleum products to file monthly reports and remit inspection fees to department of revenue.

headings.title: Sole fee deduction for exported gallons
headings.reviewNote: Requires fees to be paid on gallons imported or removed less all exports, specifying that the export deduction is the only deduction allowed.

headings.title: Annual reporting threshold
headings.reviewNote: Requires annual reporting and payment in January if previous year's total fees were less than $25, or upon discontinuance of business.

headings.title: Credit or refund for exported fee-paid product
headings.reviewNote: Allows credit or refund for inspection fees paid on regulated products subsequently shipped outside Missouri for use, sale, or distribution.

headings.title: Application of motor fuel tax administration laws
headings.reviewNote: Applies chapter 142 motor fuel tax administration, collection, and enforcement provisions to petroleum inspection fees.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1987/1998 history (effective 1-01-99); corrected subsections 2-4 titles/notes to remove hallucinated temperature basis, fix the $25 annual threshold, and include refunds.

headings.title: Deceptive motor fuel sales prohibited
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits storing, selling, or offering regulated fuels so as to deceive purchasers as to nature, quality, and identity, or under any name other than the true trade name.

headings.title: Labeling requirements for reclaimed oil
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits storing or selling reclaimed motor or lubricating oils unless drums, cans, or containers are imprinted with 'reclaimed' in contrasting half-inch lettering.

headings.title: Obstruction of director prohibited
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits hindering or obstructing director or authorized representatives in performing official inspection duties.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1987 S.B. 249 history (effective 1-01-88); all 3 headings retained and subsections 1-2 notes tightened to match archived text.

headings.title: Appointment and compensation of motor fuel inspector
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to appoint and fix compensation of motor fuel inspector to conduct fuel analyses and tests.

headings.title: Conflict of interest prohibited
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits motor fuel inspector from holding direct or indirect interest in manufacture, distribution, or sale of petroleum products.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1987 S.B. 249 history (effective 1-01-88); both headings retained covering appointment/compensation of motor fuel inspector/staff and conflict-of-interest/sample-appropriation bar.

headings.title: Criminal penalty and prosecutorial authority
headings.reviewNote: Designates violation as class A misdemeanor and empowers local prosecutors to initiate criminal actions.

headings.title: Injunctive relief and venue
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes prosecuting attorneys or attorney general to petition circuit court for preliminary or permanent injunctions.

headings.title: Violation notice, administrative hearings, and civil penalties
headings.reviewNote: Requires certified-mail violation notice with 14-day informal hearing opportunity, formal chapter 536 hearing, enforceable cease and desist orders, civil penalties up to $500 per violation and $500 per day, and circuit court appeal.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1987/1993 history notes; retained subsections 1-2 and broadened subsection 3 title/note to cover formal chapter 536 hearings, cease and desist orders, and $500 civil penalties.

headings.title: Title of act
headings.reviewNote: Cites section as Missouri Renewable Fuel Standard Act.

headings.title: Definitions
headings.reviewNote: Defines aviation fuel, distributor, fuel ethanol-blended gasoline, position holder, premium gasoline, price, qualified terminal, supplier, terminal, and unblended gasoline.

headings.title: Retail ethanol-blend mandate
headings.reviewNote: Mandates all gasoline sold at retail in Missouri be fuel ethanol-blended gasoline on and after January 1, 2008.

headings.title: Distributor pricing parity exemption
headings.reviewNote: Exempts distributors and retailers from mandate if unblended gasoline is available at lower terminal price than ethanol blend.

headings.title: Exemptions from ethanol mandate
headings.reviewNote: Exempts aviation/aircraft gasoline, premium gasoline, E75-E85, EPA exemptions, and bulk terminal transfers; authorizes additional exemptions by director rule and air-quality waivers by governor executive order.

headings.title: Enforcement provisions
headings.reviewNote: Applies penalties and enforcement provisions of section 414.152 to renewable fuel standard violations.

headings.title: Department rulemaking authority
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes department of agriculture to promulgate implementation rules subject to chapter 536 administrative procedures.

headings.title: Terminal sales requirements
headings.reviewNote: Requires Missouri terminals selling gasoline to offer ethanol-blended, fuel ethanol, and unblended gasoline in cooperation with suppliers.

headings.title: Retailer purchase freedom
headings.reviewNote: Permits retailers and distributors to purchase fuel ethanol from any terminal, producer, or supplier regardless of contract restrictions.

headings.title: Immunity for blended fuel vendors
headings.reviewNote: Shields compliant fuel vendors from property damage liability for customer-selected renewable fuel blends and provides compliant blended fuel is not a defective product.

headings.title: Manufacturer and dealer immunity for noncompliant fuel selection
headings.reviewNote: Shields vehicle and internal-combustion engine manufacturers and dealers (except for fraud or misrepresentation) from property damage liability when customer selects blended fuel not complying with owner's manual recommendations.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 2006/2016 history notes; replaced wrong subsection 11 title/note (manufacturer/dealer liability immunity, not warranty voiding) and corrected subsections 2, 5, and 10 notes.

headings.title: Renewable fuel and pump labeling rule
headings.reviewNote: Directs department of agriculture to propose rules regarding renewable fuels and motor fuel pump labeling by January 1, 2016.

headings.title: Rulemaking compliance with chapter 536
headings.reviewNote: Conditions validity of delegated pump labeling rules on compliance with chapter 536 administrative procedures.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 2015 S.B. 12 history note; both headings retained covering Jan 1, 2016 proposed pump-labeling rule deadline and chapter 536 nonseverability.

headings.title: Definitions
headings.reviewNote: Defines B-20, biodiesel (ASTM PS121), and incremental cost.

headings.title: MoDOT biodiesel fleet program
headings.reviewNote: Directs Missouri department of transportation to implement program providing opportunity to use at least B-20 biodiesel in fleet.

headings.title: Commercial availability presumption
headings.reviewNote: Establishes presumption of commercial availability if incremental cost of B-20 is not more than twenty-five cents per gallon.

headings.title: Federal Energy Policy Act limitation
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies section does not mandate biodiesel use exceeding federal Energy Policy Act of 1992 requirements.

headings.title: Revolving fund financing
headings.reviewNote: Directs department to obtain funding for incremental fuel costs from biodiesel fuel revolving fund under section 414.407.

headings.title: Department of transportation rulemaking
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director of transportation to promulgate rules implementing fleet biodiesel program.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 2002 S.B. 984 & 985 history note; all 6 headings retained and subsection 1 note corrected to list only the three defined terms.

headings.title: Definitions
headings.reviewNote: Defines alternative fuel, CAFE standard (footnote notes 15 U.S.C. 2002 repealed July 5, 1994, P.L. 103-272), department (economic development), director, state agency, and vehicle fleet (<=8,500 lbs GVWR).

headings.title: State vehicle fuel conservation program
headings.reviewNote: Directs department in consultation with commissioner of administration to implement state fleet fuel reduction and alternative fuel program.

headings.title: CAFE standard procurement compliance
headings.reviewNote: Directs commissioner of administration and agencies to identify vehicle models meeting or exceeding CAFE standards.

headings.title: Waiver of CAFE standards
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes commissioner of administration to waive CAFE procurement standards upon agency director certification for off-road/construction/road maintenance, equipment-moving, trailer-towing, or >6-passenger capacity vehicles.

headings.title: Class III vehicle purchase approval
headings.reviewNote: Requires legislative appropriation approval for purchase of class III vehicles by state departments other than highway patrol.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text, 1991-2018 history, and repealed federal statute footnote (15 U.S.C. 2002 repealed July 5, 1994); all 5 headings retained and subsections 1 and 4 notes corrected.

headings.title: Agency fleet energy conservation plans
headings.reviewNote: Requires state agencies to develop and implement vehicle fleet energy conservation plans with department assistance.

headings.title: Conservation and transportation department plans
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes departments of conservation and transportation to develop separate internal fleet conservation plans meeting statutory goals.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1991/1998 history (effective 1-01-99); both headings retained covering agency fleet energy conservation plans and separate plans for conservation and transportation departments.

headings.title: Fleet plan review and vehicle procurement
headings.reviewNote: Directs director of economic development to review fleet plans and limits state vehicle purchases to compliant models.

headings.title: Annual agency progress reports
headings.reviewNote: Requires state agencies to file annual reports on vehicle fleet conservation progress with director of economic development.

headings.title: Required contents of director's annual report
headings.reviewNote: Specifies required contents of director's annual report: progress toward goals, fuel consumption, vehicle count, miles traveled, average fuel economy, estimated cost savings, and alternative fuel use.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1991/2018 history notes; retained subsections 1-2 and corrected subsection 3 title/note to reflect required contents of the director's annual report.

headings.title: Definitions
headings.reviewNote: Defines B-20, biodiesel, department, and EPAct credit.

headings.title: EPAct credit banking and selling program
headings.reviewNote: Directs department in cooperation with department of agriculture to administer federal EPAct credit banking and sales program.

headings.title: Biodiesel fuel revolving fund creation
headings.reviewNote: Establishes biodiesel fuel revolving fund in state treasury for proceeds of EPAct credit sales.

headings.title: Use of revolving fund moneys
headings.reviewNote: Restricts fund expenditures to incremental costs of B-20 biodiesel for state agency vehicles and program administration.

headings.title: Fund nonreversion and interest retention
headings.reviewNote: Exempts revolving fund from general revenue transfers under section 33.080 and requires interest to remain in fund.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority
headings.reviewNote: Directs department to promulgate rules implementing credit banking program and revolving fund.

headings.title: Alternative fuel study and reporting
headings.reviewNote: Directs department to study alternative fuel use in Missouri motor vehicles and report findings and recommendations to general assembly by January 1, 2002.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 2001 history note; all 7 headings retained and subsection 7 note tightened to match general-assembly-only Jan 1, 2002 report.

headings.title: Alternative fuel use plan development
headings.reviewNote: Directs director to develop statewide alternative fuel plan in cooperation with fleet operators, manufacturers, and fuel distributors.

headings.title: Recommended alternative fuels for procurement
headings.reviewNote: Directs department to recommend alternative fuels for consideration by state agencies and universities during vehicle acquisition.

headings.title: Graduated alternative fuel acquisition schedule
headings.reviewNote: Sets graduated biennial alternative-fuel acquisition quotas (10%, 30%, 50%) for fleets over 15 vehicles, with early-purchase credits (archived text prints 'July l, 1994') and procurement freeze for noncompliance absent waiver.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1991/1998 history (effective 1-01-99); all 3 headings retained and archived 'July l, 1994' typo noted in subsection 3.

headings.title: Waiver or reduction of acquisition requirements
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to reduce or waive alternative fuel acquisition percentages upon agency certification of fuel unavailability or prohibitive cost.

headings.title: Agency reporting on alternative fuel vehicles
headings.reviewNote: Requires state agencies to submit reports describing acquisition, utilization, and cost data for alternative fuel vehicles.

headings.title: Mandatory ethanol blend use in state vehicles
headings.reviewNote: Requires gasoline state-owned vehicles (other than alternative-fuel vehicles) to use section 142.028 ethanol blends when competitively priced, unless EPA or governor rules restrict use in ozone nonattainment or maintenance areas.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1991-2018 history notes; all 3 headings retained and subsection 3 note aligned to competitive-price and ozone nonattainment/maintenance language.

headings.title: Exemptions for law enforcement and other specified vehicles
headings.reviewNote: Exempts purchase or lease of criminal law enforcement vehicles, motorcycles, ATVs, ambulances, and vehicles lacking EPA fuel economy comparisons from sections 414.400 to 414.417.

headings.title: Demonstration vehicles for alternative fuels
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes departments of natural resources and economic development to acquire alternative-fuel vehicles to assess and demonstrate alternative vehicles or fuels.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1991/2018 history notes; corrected both titles/notes to capture all exempted vehicle types (no CMV inspection exemption) and demonstration/assessment purpose.

headings.title: Definition of alternative fuel
headings.reviewNote: Adopts definition of alternative fuel set forth in section 414.400.

headings.title: Missouri Alternative Fuels Commission creation
headings.reviewNote: Creates nine-member Missouri Alternative Fuels Commission including legislators and gubernatorial appointees.

headings.title: Powers and duties of commission
headings.reviewNote: Directs commission to recommend law changes, promote alternative fuels/vehicles, educate consumers, develop a long-range petroleum reduction plan, and report annually to governor and general assembly.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1993/2007 history (effective 1-01-08); all 3 headings retained and subsection 3 note aligned to enumerated commission duties.

headings.title: Definitions
headings.reviewNote: Defines B-20, biodiesel, and eligible new generation cooperative.

headings.title: School district biodiesel contracts
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes school districts to contract with eligible new generation cooperatives for B-20 biodiesel through 2011-12 school year.

headings.title: Supplemental pupil transportation aid
headings.reviewNote: Provides additional section 163.161 transportation aid covering incremental biodiesel cost above regular diesel rack price, capped at 0.7% of 1998-99 entitlement (increasable 4% yearly), contingent on appropriations.

headings.title: Rulemaking by education department
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes department of elementary and secondary education to promulgate rules administering biodiesel school aid.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 2001/2005 history notes; all 4 headings retained and subsection 3 note corrected from hallucinated 20c/gal cap to 0.7% of 1998-99 section 163.161 entitlement.

headings.title: Referendum on propane council creation
headings.reviewNote: Directs director to conduct referendum among propane producers and retail marketers to establish Missouri propane education and research council.

headings.title: Referendum on continuation or termination
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes continuation or termination referenda upon petition of council or thirty-five percent of industry volume.

headings.title: Referendum records and confidentiality
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to require documentation and mandates strict confidentiality of voting and producer records.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1993/2012 history notes; all 3 headings retained covering creation referendum (two-thirds volume), termination/suspension referendum, and closed referendum records.

headings.title: Judicial enforcement of propane council provisions
headings.reviewNote: Vests state courts with jurisdiction to enforce propane council statutes and restrain noncompliance upon attorney general action.

headings.title: Civil penalties, cease and desist orders, and enforcement
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director after notice and hearing to assess $500-$5,000 civil penalties per violation and/or cease and desist orders (with up to $500/day penalty for disobeying final C&D order), subject to chapter 536 review and AG collection.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1993 S.B. 178 history note; retained subsection 1 and broadened subsection 2 title/note to include cease and desist orders and general statutory violations.

headings.title: Appointment of propane council members
headings.reviewNote: Directs director to appoint council members from industry nominee lists upon order establishing council.

headings.title: Industry and geographic representation
headings.reviewNote: Requires nominee selections to ensure fair representation of industry segments and state geographic regions.

headings.title: Council composition
headings.reviewNote: Establishes fifteen-member council composed of nine retail marketers, three wholesalers, two equipment manufacturers, and one public representative.

headings.title: Reimbursement of expenses
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits compensation for council members while authorizing reimbursement for reasonable official expenses.

headings.title: Staggered terms of office
headings.reviewNote: Sets three-year terms for council members with initial appointments staggered in one-, two-, and three-year groups.

headings.title: Officers, committees, and bylaws
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes council to elect chairman and officers, establish committees, and adopt bylaws and advisory committees.

headings.title: Employment of executive officer and personnel
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes employment of president as chief executive officer, staff hiring, and contracting with industry organizations.

headings.title: Annual budget and assessment plan
headings.reviewNote: Requires preparation and public submission of annual budget plan and recommended assessment rate thirty days before fiscal period.

headings.title: Research, education, and marketing programs
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes council to develop research, education, safety, and marketing programs and enter into implementation contracts.

headings.title: Records, minutes, and annual audit
headings.reviewNote: Mandates maintenance of detailed minutes and books and requires annual audit by certified public accountant.

headings.title: Reimbursement of departmental expenses
headings.reviewNote: Requires council to reimburse director annually from assessments for referendum and direct administrative expenses.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1993-2012 history notes; all 11 headings retained covering propane council selection, representation, 15-member composition, expenses, 3-year staggered terms, officers, staff, budget, programs, CPA audits, and director reimbursement.

headings.title: Assessment rate limit and adjustment
headings.reviewNote: Caps initial assessment at one-tenth of one cent per gallon and provides for subsequent cost-based rate setting.

headings.title: Assessment liability and payment points
headings.reviewNote: Places payment liability on owner immediately prior to odorization or owner at time of importing odorized propane.

headings.title: Alternative collection and late charges
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes council regulations establishing alternative collection methods, late payment charges, and interest not exceeding the legal rate for judgments.

headings.title: Permissible investment of assessment funds
headings.reviewNote: Restricts investment of undisbursed council funds to federal, state, and federally-insured financial instruments.

headings.title: Rulemaking compliance with chapter 536
headings.reviewNote: Conditions validity of delegated assessment rules on compliance with chapter 536 administrative procedures.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1993/2012 history notes; all 5 headings retained and subsection 3 note corrected from 1.5%/month to legal rate for judgments.
